semiconductor_relevance: High — Nippon Koshuha Co., Ltd. specializes in microwave technology that is integral to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Nippon Koshuha Co., Ltd. develops and supplies microwave oscillators and automatic matching units for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Their products enhance equipment efficiency and stability, supporting various applications in plasma sources and heat treatment.
capabilities: Automatic matching unit for microwave transmission
Magnetron-type microwave oscillator for plasma and heating applications
